message.reasoning_content:
The vendor has been known since 2024-01-08. No aliases were found. Earlier invoices are empty.

No reject-severity findings were found. The invoice total is $5,940, so the extra scrutiny rule for amounts over $10,000 does not apply. The risk memo is low, which is acceptable. Math checks out: line item amounts are null but the subtotal matches the calculated values.

The revision note and missing prior version are only a validator observation. They do not indicate fraud. Unverified doubts about the empty earlier-invoice history are insufficient to reject.

The GadgetX stock check passed. It is an operational note, not a reason to block payment.

The invoice is sound and should be approved.

Reasons that do not rest on a finding can have empty finding_ids.

The due date is one day later than standard Net 30 from January 22. The document itself does not show this as a defect, so it is insufficient to reject.
